title: CIDG: 3 Japanese, 1 Filipina nabbed for marriage-for-jobs scheme

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Three Japanese nationals and a Filipina were arrested in Manila for allegedly arranging marriages between Japanese men and Filipino women under a scheme that promised brides faster access to jobs in Japan, the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) said on Thursday. The operation stemmed from a complaint by a woman who said the suspects had arranged her marriage to a Japanese national, promising that the arrangement would facilitate her employment in Japan. However, the complainant said she was not sent to Japan after the wedding. She later learned that the suspects were arranging another marriage, prompting her to report […]...
